data.one_liner: Manage global state and persist variables using InheritedModel.
data.what_it_does: A wrapper over InheritedModel that lets you manage global state in Flutter apps with low boilerplate. It can be used anywhere in Dart code even without a BuildContext, and supports optional persistence via shared_preferences.
use_when: You want simple global state management without complex boilerplate
You need to access and update state outside of a BuildContext
You want optional automatic persistence to shared preferences
avoid_when: Your project requires a strictly scoped, non-global state architecture
You prefer stream-based or reactive state management solutions like BLoC
strengths: Works anywhere in Dart code even without a BuildContext
Only rebuilds widgets that subscribe to updates using .of(context)
Built-in support for persisting values using shared_preferences
weaknesses: Relies on global variables which can make testing harder
Very limited documentation and changelog history
data.setup_notes: Wrap your root app widget with SharedValue.wrapApp().

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need key-value storage without the global state wrapper.
